title: Finch Circle Extension of the Complimentary Alterations Window (Marlowe & Finch Alterations)
content:
A Finch Circle window extension is added to the complimentary window of Marlowe & Finch Alterations — the period after a purchase's completed date within which a garment must be dropped off for complimentary basic work. The extension follows the member's tier in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program:

| Customer | Finch Circle window extension |
|---|---|
| Active member at Finch Circle Diamond or Icon (a tier whose qualifying spend threshold is 5000.00 USD or more) | 60 calendar days |
| Active Finch Circle Platinum member (tier threshold 2500.00 USD, below 5000.00 USD) | 30 calendar days |
| Anyone else | none |

**Records read.** The tier of the customer's Finch Circle membership and whether it is active.

## Hypothetical illustration

In a class whose own complimentary window is, for this example, 60 days, the window of an active Platinum member is longer by 30 calendar days and that of an active Icon member by 60 calendar days; a Gold member's window is not extended.

| Membership | Extension |
|---|---|
| Icon, active | 60 calendar days |
| Diamond, active | 60 calendar days |
| Platinum, active | 30 calendar days |
| Gold, active | none |
| Platinum, not active | none |
